newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh private bank to issue $100 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh private bank to issue $100 mln Eurobond.

text.p: Kazakhstan's AO Kazkommertsbank plans to issue a three-year $100 million Eurobond by the end of the year, to be lead-managed by Dutch bank ING Barings Ltd, Kazkommertsbank's deputy chairman said on Friday.

"We have directed ING Barings to lead a three-year $100 million Eurobond, to be issued before the end of the year," Askar Ashimbayev, deputy chairman of Kazkommertsbank, one of the former Soviet republic's largest private banks, told Reuters.
